note.zh: 在 Codex CLI 中使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813（xhigh 思考配额）多轮迭代完成的 React 18 + TypeScript + Three.js 工程。作者明确披露本次并非一次性裸测评：开发期间安装依赖、运行 TypeScript 检查与生产构建，并用无头浏览器检查首屏和 Canvas，修复了地图导航路径与墙体碰撞不一致的问题。因此本产物仅作展示，永久排除出 Arena 盲评、投票、排行榜与达标场次计算；提交保留了用于复现构建的完整工程。
note.en: A React 18 + TypeScript + Three.js project completed in Codex CLI with DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 at xhigh thinking effort through iterative development. The contributor explicitly discloses that this was not a bare one-shot benchmark run: dependencies were installed, TypeScript checks and the production build were run, a headless browser was used to verify the first screen and canvas, and map navigation and wall-collision mismatches were fixed. The artifact is therefore showcase-only and permanently excluded from Arena, voting, rankings, and qualification counts; the complete reproducible project is retained.
